title: THE SELF-HEALING PULSE — GitHub's scheduler starves the repo, so the fleet holds its own heartbeat; plus the ledger-first day-truth fix that re-arms the loss breaker
operator_directive: תמשיך (continue — Z-70 wave, following 'תמשיך נסה לשפר את זה לייעל משמעותית מאוד')
target: the reflex arc itself (sovereign-tick / earn-audit / fill-ledger cadence + the day-truth the gate reads)

findings.evidence: keyless GitHub API 2026-10-03: sovereign-tick-cron (:12/:42) and earn-audit-cron (:07/:37) registered ZERO schedule events since arming — 3 runs, all workflow_dispatch; scheduled runs that did fire arrived hours late (treasury-route 16:20 slot ran 20:09; economy-engine 20:17 slot ran 20:06). Dispatch latency measured 15-30s (21:15:04Z dispatch → 21:15:22Z decision).

the old Math.max(state, ledger) fusion in sovereign-tick.cjs swallowed NEGATIVE realized — a losing day read 0.000 SBD forever, silently DISARMING BREAKER-DAILY-LOSS (the -0.05 SBD stop could never fire from ledger truth). On a day measuring realized -0.178154 SBD the gate saw the max of state-vs-ledger, never the loss.

14 cron collisions across 43 workflows (two workflows sharing one minute = contention multiplies the starvation surface); reslotted to 0 collisions across 21 touched workflows; the map is booked as agents/minute-map.json (SAOS-MINUTE-MAP/1).

implementation: agents/tick-keeper.cjs (the pulse): reads the arc's own receipts (sovereign-decisions.jsonl / earn-audit.json / fill-ledger.json), keeperDecide pure (exported), re-fires stale or never-born desks via PAT workflow_dispatch (PAT events DO trigger workflows — the GITHUB_TOKEN recursion block does not apply), 20m per-desk cooldown, STASIS-first (the healer obeys the breaker), single-writer (only its two book files), token env-only never printed, fail-soft exit 0 with fail-loud book, require.main guard
.github/workflows/tick-keeper.yml: cron 2,32 (clean minutes per the map), STASIS gate step, WEAVE_OPS_PAT as KEEPER_GH_TOKEN env, publish twin-idiom with autostash
agents/minute-map.json: the collision census + reslot record (14 → 0)

21 workflows reslotted to clean minutes (sovereign-tick 12,42→11,41; fill-ledger 17,47→18,48; web-publish →6,26,46; market-grid →21,51; grid-trigger-twin →8,38; econ-desk →14/4; ladder-refresh →36/6; recruit 04:44; daily-claim 02:34; content-reviewer 05:04; audience-analyst 05:31; daily-digest 01:05; content-campaign 13:05; economy-engine →22/2; agent-verify →56/2; sovereign-selftests 06:25; foundry-mesh-tests 05:27; fleet-census 02:14; org-selftests 03:23; dex-grid 03:43)

sovereign.cjs: +ledgerDayTruth(state, ledgerRow) pure exported — the ledger row IS the day-book; ledger wins when present; state is the honest fallback; sovereign-tick.cjs wired to it (Math.max fusion deleted)
agents/earn-audit.cjs: MAX_PAGES 4 → 30 (400 ops hid the drip on rotation days — headcorner's 7d window covered only ~404 ops; 30 pages ≈ 3000 ops/account), pagesUsed/oldestScanned booked honestly
evals: E29 fixture healed to the reslot (23,53 → 21,51), E32 cron regex quote-agnostic (the reslot wrote "14 2 * * *" double-quoted), + E39a/E39b → suite v1.27.0 = 40/40 GREEN
